relations.description: GUTI reallocation procedure includes sending GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message
GUTI reallocation procedure expects reception of GUTI REALLOCATION COMPLETE message
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message contains GUTI information element
GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message may contain TAI list information element
GUTI reallocation procedure starts timer T3450 for supervision
On T3450 expiry, network retransmits GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND message
Lower layer failure establishes GUTI validity management behavior
Paging procedure uses S-TMSI for identifying UE
Paging procedure during eDRX starts timer T3415 for paging attempts
After fifth T3450 expiry, network follows paging procedure as in lower layer failure case
